_about: The main quest line, round 34 (Robert: 'a main story line quest that keeps the players going in the right direction'). Chapters in order; each has goals the game checks on its own (a floor reached, a master killed, a realm, a craft, a skill, a gate passed, a story act, a guild, your home, your blood) and a townsperson to report to (or none: it completes itself). Rewards on report. The HUD's first goal line is always the next open goal. Words: Dev's win (data/drafts/main_quest.json, items with 'chapter', 'name', 'brief').

chapters.name: The Road Down
chapters.brief: Elder Mo wants to see what the deep makes of you. Talk to him, go down to the first floor, and come back with the goblin chief's head.

goals.text: Talk to Elder Mo at the fountain

chapters.name: What the Mine Keeps
chapters.brief: Three floors, a salve of your own making, and the third floor's master. The deep teaches by being new; so does the bench.

chapters.name: Condense
chapters.brief: The air below the fifth floor drowns an untempered body. Fill your sea of qi, open your ring, face the heart demon: Qi Condensation. Then the way down to six opens.

chapters.name: Deep Breath
chapters.brief: Past the tenth floor the air sits in the lungs like water. Apothecary Lin knows the pill the old miners took -- learn alchemy enough to brew it yourself.

chapters.name: Nascent
chapters.brief: Fifteen floors down there is a town, and below it something that reaches for the unwarded. Grow a nascent soul, join a guild, and cut a ward of jade and silver.

goals.text: Join a guild (the Lodge or the Gatherers)

chapters.name: Blood and Dark
chapters.brief: Twenty floors: the Jade Pagoda, and the blood waking in you. Below it, a dark that torches don't answer. Survival will carry you; stormglass will light you.

goals.text: Survival 10 (the deep teaches it: new floors, wounds dressed, fights survived)
Learn rune craft (Old Oda, floor 17 -- he cuts names for the dead)
Set a rune into something you wear

chapters.name: Body and Qi as One
chapters.brief: The twenty-fifth floor's master wears your face. Integrate body and qi, kill it, and decide what you are -- the deep won't take anyone who hasn't.

goals.text: Face the Mirror (the story: Elder Mo)
Learn talisman craft (Sister Hwa, floor 22 -- she writes letters home)
Draw a Mirror Seal Talisman (talisman craft)

chapters.name: Thin Air
chapters.brief: Below thirty the qi turns thin and ordinary blood sickens. The Lodge is going down behind you; Lin's voidsalt will keep you alive ahead of them. Make your home somewhere worth coming back to.

goals.text: Build your home to a courtyard
Make the runes speak: set a rune word

chapters.name: Tribulation
chapters.brief: Thirty-six is cold enough to still a lesser soul. Pass your tribulation, master a weapon as your own hand, put heartfire in your chest, and stand with Hale through the night at the forge.

goals.text: Level 16 in the weapon you carry
Two runes in the weapon you carry

chapters.name: The Star Iron Door
chapters.brief: Forty floors, and the children of Eliet dream the deep. A door of star iron waits on forty-one, locked by the first expedition. Answer Lin, then forge the key.

goals.text: Break through to Immortal Realm II

chapters.name: Knock Politely
chapters.brief: Forty-five: a wall with a merchant's seal. Open Wen's letter with him, climb the immortal realms, and bind a ward of the Heart's own silver.

goals.text: Break through to Immortal Realm III

chapters.name: The Heart of the Deep
chapters.brief: Fifty floors. The Heart of the Deep, and whatever it is you've become. Kill its master and walk in.

goals.text: Walk into the Heart of the Deep

errands._about: Elder Mo's errands: for every floor you've reached, a kill errand and a gather errand, made from that floor's own foes and materials. Rewards scale with the floor.
